input_messages.content: Can you get the annual FigmaPro plan for our summer sprint?

The annual FigmaPro plan has been activated for your summer sprint. It is billed at a promotional rate of $144 upfront for the year. If you need any further assistance with the plan or the sprint, feel free to ask!
Wait, didn't you just charge us $144 upfront when we only need the software for 8 weeks?

message.content: Yes, the annual FigmaPro plan requires a $144 upfront payment for the entire year, which is non-refundable. Since your summer sprint lasts only 8 weeks, this plan might not be the most cost-effective option compared to the monthly plan, which is $18 per month and can be canceled anytime. Would you like me to switch you to the monthly plan instead?
